angle: Trade associations, trade shows and directories. CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026 exhibitor directory: all 29 relevant product categories under Aggregates, Asphalt, Concrete and Earthmoving & Material Handling. That gave 786 unique exhibitor IDs; every exhibitor detail page was rendered and the 462 US-addressed exhibitors were screened by description. Also used: the AEM member directory product categories (Aggregate, Asphalt, Attachments, Concrete, Earthmoving: 602 member names; detail pages carry no address, so names were resolved separately) and Curlie directory categories (Quarry and Aggregate Production, Mining, Earthmoving). Multi-plant parents were resolved to plants via company sites and SEC 10-K Item 2 property lists (Caterpillar FY2024, Deere FY2025, CNH FY2025, Terex FY2025, Alamo FY2025), plus the Astec brand-address page. Four product-query web searches at the end served as the dry-point test. EPA ECHO/FRS and NAICS-coded lists were not used. The Equipment Components category was not screened.
notes:
NOT DRY: the run stopped to save the shared search budget (15 web searches; about 900 page fetches, mostly directory pages). Each of the four closing product searches (crushers/screens, buckets/attachments, stackers/conveyors, underground mining) still found 1-3 US fabricators the directories had missed: RD Olson, TAG Manufacturing, East Attachments, Fluent Conveyors and J.H. Fletcher were added. Yield per source: ConExpo about 132 in-definition plants, AEM-surfaced OEM resolution about 18, dry-test searches about 1 per search. Crushing, screening, asphalt and concrete plant makers look near saturation; attachments, buckets and small conveyor fabricators do not.

FIELDS. in_definition reflects product scope only. plant_confirmed=false (21 rows) means a welding plant at that address is not established: HQ/office/PO box, or a distribution-vs-manufacturing doubt. Rows include Cedarapids, Terex Louisville, Telsmith Mequon, Wacker, Volvo, Liebherr, LBX, BOMAG, HAZEMAG, NPK, Paladin, Stansteel, Fluent, TerraSource, Mellott, Pemberton, Belt Tech, Reliable, Quinn, Yanmar/ASV and Fletcher. tools/compare_audit.py ignores plant_confirmed, so filter on it when computing the miss rate. Boundary rows (32: wood/organics grinders, forestry, paving/compaction machines, dredges, process screeners, compact-equipment attachments, drill attachments, wear fabrication) carry 'boundary'/'BOUNDARY' in note. Core = 110 in-definition, non-boundary, plant-confirmed rows. Where a source places only a segment (10-K tables), products quotes the source and note gives auditor recall. quote_verified=true means `tools/fetch_page.py URL --check quote` returned FOUND on 2026-11-16 (all 161).

SURFACED BUT NOT RESOLVED to a plant (not in list): Komatsu Chattanooga and Franklin PA; JCB; Manitou/Gehl (Yankton/Madison SD); Kubota; Epiroc (Garland TX); Hitachi; Sandvik; Metso; Philippi-Hagenbuch; Bucyrus Blades; Stamler; Bobcat Litchfield, Rogers and Johnson Creek (listed as manufacturing, products unknown); Amulet; Steel Unlimited; Pit Portable; CAI Industries; Hurricane Attachments; JM Attachments; Burchland; Pro-Dig; Takeuchi/Kobelco/Develon/HD Hyundai/LiuGong (US offices only).

SOURCE FAILURES: CEMA member directory (Cloudflare 403); Wayback Machine (proxy resets); MINExpo 2024 directory (mine2024.mapyourshow.com now redirects to the homepage); Thomasnet (bot block); Pit & Quarry (Cloudflare); NSSGA directory (404); caterpillar.com (502); several company sites unreachable through the proxy (Philippi-Hagenbuch, Bucyrus Blades, Stamler, Steel Unlimited, Pit Portable).

BLIND SPOTS: directories list brands and headquarters, not plants; non-exhibiting contract fabricators and Tier 1/2 weldment suppliers (booms, frames, hydraulic tanks) are missed, and the Equipment Components category was never screened; captive OEM plants in small towns are hard to resolve; with CEMA unreachable, conveyor makers are under-covered; with MINExpo dead, underground and surface mining OEMs are under-covered; Curlie is years out of date.
